FN-EJS4L22-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 186
Committee: Children and Youth Health Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/26/2025
Senate Bill 186 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General for the enforcement of certain consumer protections regarding device filters for
internet-enabled devices as provided by this bill; however, these obligations may be offset by
any civil penalties, up to $5,000 per violation and $50,000 in the aggregate, attorney's fees, or
investigation expenses that are recovered from violators of the provisions of this bill and
retained by the Attorney General.
